projectDescription: Android app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, Material 3 Expressive) that traverses the AniList relation graph to recommend sequels, films, OVAs and spin-offs from a user's completed anime and manga, with one-tap Planning, a self-contained signed-APK updater and no Play Services.
readmeHead: Your AniList history, read backwards. AniSequel walks the relation graph of every anime and manga you have finished and finds the sequels, films, OVAs and spin-offs you never got around to - then puts the good ones one tap from your Planning list.
